integrity: The analytical proof is supplied; finite reproducibility checks supplement but do not certify it. Independent validation and publication-priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for two rank-one complex square matrices of equal sole singular value and 1<p<2 only. The sharp unrestricted two-summand constant remains open. A possible equivalent theorem under alternate terminology and external priority remain unresolved.
title: Sharp equal-singular-value rank-one Schatten comparison below exponent two
